runner.install_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3-pip && printf '[global]\nbreak-system-packages = true\n' > /etc/pip.conf && python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages --disable-pip-version-check 'pytest==8.3.5' 'freezegun==1.5.2' 'flit_core>=3.11,<4' && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
runner.env_probe_command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import os; import signtoken; from signtoken import URLSafeSerializer; assert os.path.realpath(signtoken.__file__).startswith(os.path.realpath('src')); s=URLSafeSerializer('secret key', 'auth'); token=s.dumps({'id': 5, 'name': 'probe'}); assert s.loads(token)=={'id': 5, 'name': 'probe'}"

init_metadata.tech_stack: Pure Python cryptographic signing helpers for untrusted payloads (flit_core src layout, zero runtime deps, pytest); CPU-only

hardware_requirements.summary: This is a pure-Python library that cryptographically signs serialized payloads so they can be sent to untrusted environments and verified on return. It has no compiled extensions, native code, or GPU/accelerator requirements, and zero declared runtime dependencies. The documented interpreter floor is Python 3.10 or newer. Any standard x86_64 or arm64 Linux, macOS, or Windows host with a supported interpreter is sufficient to install from source and run the test suite.

profiles.label: CPU baseline
profiles.description: Standard CPU-only Python execution path. Core capability is signing a small mapping into a compact token and verifying that loading the token recovers the original mapping.
probes: cd /opt/codingbench/repo && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import signtoken, os; assert os.path.realpath(signtoken.__file__).startswith(os.path.realpath('src')); from signtoken import URLSafeSerializer; s=URLSafeSerializer('secret-key'); token=s.dumps({'id': 5}); assert s.loads(token)=={'id': 5}"
profiles.setup_notes: pyproject.toml requires-python >=3.10; the tests dependency group is pytest and freezegun. No system libraries beyond a normal Python toolchain. Documented tox environments also include style, typing, and docs.
profiles.build_notes: No compiled/native build step. Packaging uses flit_core (pyproject.toml [build-system] requires flit_core<4); the importable package lives under the src layout. Editable install: pip install -e .
